guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: Learn how to create a song, play it in the player, and describe it using Armonia's CMD format.
guide.gettingStartedBody: Armonia works with .md or .txt text files. You can write a song in the Editor or open an existing file directly in the Player.
guide.editorBody: The Editor lets you write a CMD file alongside its formatted preview.
guide.editorWrite: Write a song or open a local file; its content stays on your device.
guide.editorPreview: The preview updates as you type and displays the title, subtitle, key, links, sections, and chords.
guide.editorHints: Metadata suggestions and line diagnostics help correct common mistakes.
guide.editorExport: Save the .md file, open it in the Player, or generate/print a PDF from the preview.
guide.playerBody: The Player is designed for reading and performing an existing song without changing its original file.
guide.playerTranspose: Transpose the song up to 12 semitones in either direction and reset transposition using the central value.
guide.playerScroll: Start automatic scrolling and set song duration between 30 and 300 seconds.
guide.playerDisplay: Choose notation, chord detail, and text size from the additional controls.
guide.playerEdit: Open the song in the Editor to change it, or export/print it as PDF.
guide.playerPdf: Use the PDF button to export the formatted song preview, including its title, subtitle, key, sections, lyrics, and chords.
guide.preferencesBody: Preferences define the defaults used by the Player and preview.
guide.preferencesAppearance: Language, theme, and chord color customize your reading view.
guide.preferencesMusic: Choose Italian or international notation, full/simplified/bass/hidden chords, the split-word filler, autoscroll speed, and text size.
guide.preferencesLocal: Preferences are stored locally in this device's browser.
guide.cmdBody: CMD (Chord Markdown) is a text format: optional frontmatter contains metadata, ## headings divide sections, and chords in square brackets are positioned within lyric lines.
guide.metadataIntro: Put metadata between two --- lines at the start of the file.
guide.metadataKey: Key in the selected notation, for example C or DO.
guide.metadataLinks: External links, preferably one per indented line.
guide.sectionsBody: Any Markdown heading from # through ###### creates a section; names are free-form, such as Intro, Verse, Chorus, or Bridge.
guide.chordsBody: Write chords in square brackets where they begin over the lyrics. Italian and international notation, accidentals, minors, extensions, and slash bass notes are supported.
guide.spacingBody: One or more blank lines inside a section produce a single visual break in the song. Blank lines near the beginning or end of a section are ignored.
guide.linksBody: The multiline form keeps files easier to read. YouTube, Spotify, audio, and website have dedicated icons in the preview.
guide.linksNote: Other types with an http or https URL are accepted and displayed as web links. The pdf type is reserved for app export and is ignored in metadata.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Armonia is designed to work locally in the browser. This page summarizes what data is handled and where it stays.
privacy.localFilesBody: When you open a .md or .txt file, its content is read by the browser only to generate the preview, player, and print view. The app does not upload the file to a server.
privacy.noBackendBody: Armonia currently does not use a backend to store songs, accounts, or history. Songs are processed in memory during the current session.
privacy.storageBody: The app may use localStorage to remember technical preferences such as language and theme. These values stay in your browser.
privacy.exportBody: When you save a .md file or generate a PDF, the content is produced locally on the device. You decide where to store or share it.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: Bootstrap and icons are included in the app assets. Music links in song metadata are opened only when you select them.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: Manage the basic app preferences stored on this device.
preferences.languageDescription: Choose the language used by the app interface.
preferences.themeDescription: Choose the visual theme used across the app.
preferences.preferredNotationDescription: Choose the notation you normally want to use.
preferences.chordDisplayDescription: Choose the default amount of chord detail shown in the player.
preferences.chordColorDescription: Choose the color used to highlight chords in previews.
preferences.wordSplitFillDescription: Choose what to insert when dense chords force a word to split.
preferences.autoScrollDescription: Choose the default scroll duration for a song.
preferences.textSizeDescription: Choose the default text size adjustment in the player.
preferences.metadataDescription: Show the song key and links in the player.
